send.notice.title: Your collection time has run out
send.shopChoice.title: {shop} is closed — where will you collect it?

send.shopChoice.settledOne: It goes to {shop} now, as you chose. You are told when it is ready to collect there.

send.shopChoice.settled: The bag went to {shop}. You are told when it is ready to collect there.

send.notice.choice.relinquish: You said you do not want it.

send.parcels.abroad.customsDetail: Customs has not decided on it yet.
send.parcels.abroad.heldReceiver: Pay it to {payee} by {date}, reference {reference}. Not paid by then, it goes back to the sender.
send.parcels.abroad.thenOurs: Then you pay {amount} at the shop: our clearance fee and the last leg.
send.parcels.abroad.heldSender: The receiver is asked to pay {amount} to customs by {date}. If they do not, you are asked what to do with it: coming back to you is at your cost.
send.parcels.abroad.lapsedSender: The receiver did not pay customs in time. Tell us what is done with it: coming back to you is at your cost.
send.parcels.abroad.lapsedReceiver: It was not paid in time, so it goes back to the sender.
send.parcels.abroad.payAtShop: You pay {amount} when you collect it: our clearance fee and the last leg.
send.parcels.abroad.onToShop: It goes on to the receiver’s shop.
send.parcels.abroad.how: How a parcel from abroad works
send.parcels.abroad.chooseTitle: Not paid in time: what happens to it?
send.parcels.abroad.someoneElseLede: Someone else in that country can take it. They pay customs, our fee, the warehouse days, the extra handling and the last leg there. Give them the new release code from this app.
send.parcels.abroad.giveUpSure: Given up, customs disposes of it, and it cannot be undone.
send.parcels.abroad.givenUpSender: You gave it up. The warehouse hands it to customs to dispose of.
send.parcels.abroad.givenUpReceiver: Its sender gave it up: it will not come.
send.parcels.abroad.thenOursMore: Then you pay {amount} at the shop: our clearance fee, the warehouse days, the extra handling and the last leg.
send.parcels.abroad.someoneElseSender: You named someone else to take it. They have until {date} to pay customs. Give them the new release code above.
send.parcels.withdrawnSender: It comes back to you, to the shop you handed it in at, as {id}. It is under Received, with its own code.
send.parcels.withdrawnReceiver: It goes back to its sender. It will not come to you.
send.parcels.comesBackPay: Pay {amount} in cash when you collect it
send.parcels.comesBackDetail: It brings back your parcel {id}, withdrawn at a hub, to the shop you handed it in at. The shop asks for the way back as it hands it over.
send.door.offer: Bring it to my door instead
send.door.offerHint: You pay first by M-Pesa, up to the most you allow. A driver brings it to your door; what they charge less comes back to your number.
send.door.wherePh: A street, a gate, a landmark a driver can find
send.door.pinned: Your door is where you put the pin.
send.door.geoFound: Found: {where}. Move the pin to your gate if it is not exact.
send.door.geoNotFound: We could not find that. Put the pin on the map yourself.
send.door.no: It cannot come to your door
send.door.mostLabel: The most you allow a driver ({currency})
send.door.suggested: We suggest {amount}: what a car would be paid for this at its busiest. A driver may ask less, never more.
send.door.phoneLabel: Your M-Pesa number — the driver calls it at your door
send.door.awaitingDetail: M-Pesa asked {phone} for it. Pay by {until}, or it comes to the shop as before.
send.door.giveUp: Give up: it comes to the shop
send.door.postedDetail: Load {code} brings it to {label}. What the driver charges less than this comes back to your number.
send.door.toShop: Send it to {shop} instead — all of it back
send.door.raiseBody: No driver has taken load {code} for {paid} yet. Allow more, and drivers near the hub are told again. What the driver charges less than the new most comes back to your number.
send.door.raiseDiff: M-Pesa asks you for the difference, {amount}, on your number ending {last}.
send.door.raiseAwaitingDetail: M-Pesa asked {phone} for it. Pay by {until} and the most becomes {to}; if not, it stays as it is.
send.door.raiseLapsedTitle: The most stays as it was
send.door.raiseLapsedDetail: The raise to {to} was not paid: drivers still see {paid}. You can raise it again.
send.door.takenTitle: A driver is bringing it to your door
send.door.takenDetail: Load {code}: {billed} of the {paid} you paid. The rest comes back to your number once it is delivered.
send.door.deliveredDetail: {amount} goes back to your number ending {last} with the next payout.
send.door.toShopDetail: As parcel {id}: you pay for it in cash there as you collect it. {amount} goes back to your number ending {last}.
send.door.lapsedDetail: It comes to the shop as before. While it is still at the hub, you can ask again.
send.door.reversedDetail: It comes to the shop as before.
send.parcels.lostTitle: We could not find this parcel
send.parcels.lostDetail: SeeBuyGet looked for it and declared it lost on {when}: {reason} The damage claim report below is yours, to pass to whoever covers it. If it turns up, you are told.
send.parcels.foundTitle: It was lost, and found again
send.parcels.foundDetail: Found on {when}: {note} It carries on from where it was.

send.track.offDetail: Ask at {dest} — they can see what happened.

send.push.reason: We will tell you the moment a parcel reaches the shop you collect it from, and when one you sent is delivered — on this device, even with the app closed.
send.parcels.codeHeld.title: Your collection code shows here from {when}
send.parcels.codeHeld.detail: Your account was moved to a new phone number without your PIN. To keep your parcel safe, its code was changed and is hidden for 24 hours after the move. The parcel waits for you, and its free collection time does not run out meanwhile.
send.parcels.codeHeld.detailNamed: Your account was moved to a new phone number without your PIN. To keep your parcel safe, its code was changed and is hidden for 24 hours after the move — and so was the code {name} has: give them the new one when it shows. The parcel waits for you, and its free collection time does not run out meanwhile.
send.parcels.oldNumber.title: This was sent to your old number

send.parcels.emptyNoCode: No code to type — it is your account

send.parcels.freightNote: Orders too big for the parcel network — carried on a dedicated truck.
